content:
We're back with an update on what's new this week at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store. Highlights this week include the MacBook Neo, new MacBook Air configurations, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and other products.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store is a great way to save money, allowing you to buy Apple products from Apple's official website at up to 15% off.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Quality assured, prices reduced
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before sale
  • Comes with Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare products can be purchased separately
  • Refurbished products are not eligible for engraving or gift wrapping services

We'll track every addition and removal at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store so you don't have to check yourself. Inventory changes quickly, and we hope this report lets you know what's currently in stock so you can snap it up before it sells out.

Mac

The MacBook Neo and MacBook Air remain the most attractive options in terms of price. Both are excellent for those entering the Apple ecosystem for the first time, or upgrading to a product with Apple Silicon chips.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo with 256GB storage: $599 (original price for new: $699)
  • MacBook Neo with 512GB storage and Touch ID: $679 (original price for new: $799)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,099 (original price for new: $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 1TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,529 (original price for new: $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 2TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,949 (original price for new: $2,299)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 256GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,269 (original price for new: $1,499)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,439 (original price for new: $1,699)

Studio Display

A few weeks ago, we first reported that the Studio Display XDR could be purchased through the Apple Refurbished Store. As always, inventory changes can happen quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR with standard glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $2,799 (original price for new: $3,299)
  • Studio Display XDR with nano-texture glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $3,059 (original price for new: $3,599)

Apple TV 4K

The always-popular base-model Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, along with the long-available higher-end model with Ethernet. The base model usually sells out quickly, so don't hesitate if you want one.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (original price for new: $199)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet: $209 (original price for new: $249)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear the Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day. If you're looking to join in, the Apple Refurbished Store has some pretty good deals this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with Black Ocean Band: $679 (original price for new: $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with Anchor Blue Ocean Band: $679 (original price for new: $799)

As always, you can follow the latest Apple deals throughout the week at 9to5Tocks.
